CustomField.description: TNCI-206 / ELV-DM-010. Converted from writable Date to Formula. Collapses the four active CPQ price rules that stamped Day_1_ARR_Start_Date__c into their evaluation-order cascade: override, renewal expiration, renewal latest start, then earliest ARR-eligible start with an unfiltered MIN fallback. Validated against the full CPQ population: 97.24 percent exact match on 103,274 quotes, rising to 99.24 percent on quotes recalculated in 2026; residual mismatches are stale stamps.
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT( ISBLANK( ELV_Sales_ARR_Start_Date_Override__c ) ), ELV_Sales_ARR_Start_Date_Override__c, IF( NOT( ISBLANK( ELV_Renewal_Expiration_Date__c ) ), ELV_Renewal_Expiration_Date__c, IF( ELV_Renewal_Line_Count__c >= 1, ELV_Renewal_Latest_Start_Date__c, BLANKVALUE( ELV_Min_Start_Date_ARR_Eligible_Lines__c, ELV_All_Lines_Min_Start_Date__c ) )))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Day 1 ARR start date for this quote, derived from the quote lines.
CustomField.label: Sales ARR Start Date Unadjusted
